title: Intebe y'Ukuri .
intro: Umutware w’ububasha, azwi kubera ubukerebutsi bwiwe buhambaye be n’intebe y’ubwami yiwe nziza cane, araronka ubutumwa bw’akabanga buva ahantu hatazwi. Ukwo guhanahana amakuru batavyiteze kuratera ingorane ivyo bemera n’ubukuru bwabo, bikabashira mu rugendo rw’ubudiplomate ruzogerageza ubwenge bwabo, amaherezo rukabajana mu kuvyuka cane mu vy’impwemu. Woba ushobora guhishura akaranga k’uwo mwami be n’ibintu vyahinduye ubwami bwabo bwose?
clues: Jewe n’abantu banje twasenga izuba, dukurikiza inzira za ba sogokuruza.
Inyoni, ari yo hoopoe, ni yo ntumwa idasanzwe yanzaniye ikete rivuye ku murongozi akomeye.
Kugira ngo ngerageze ubwenge bw’uwatumye, narungitse ingabirano z’agaciro, ariko zirasubirwamwo, kuko uwo yatumye yari afise ubutunzi bwinshi cane buva kuri Allah.
Imbere mbere y’uko ngera ku rugo rw’uwantumye, intebe yanje y’ubwami nziza cane yaratwawe ng’aho ku gitangaro mu kanya nk’ako gukubita urugohe.
Maze gushika, barambajije nimba iyo ntebe y'ubwami batwaye ari iyanje, nanje ndababwira nti: 'Ni nk'aho ari yo nyene.'
Naciye ninjira mu cumba kinini gifise hasi narihenda ko ari ikidengeri c’amazi, muri ako kanya k’ubwoba, ndiyorosha iruhande y’Umuhanuzi Sulaimani kuri Allah, Umukama w’isi.

arabic: قِيلَ لَهَا ٱدْخُلِى ٱلصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةًۭ وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ صَرْحٌۭ مُّمَرَّدٌۭ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّى ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verse: She was told, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins [to wade through]. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace [whose floor is] made smooth with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allāh, Lord of the worlds." (27:44)
